results.name: All five resources can be gathered on contact, from hexes you own
results.evidence:
wood: 3->5 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 24, hex 1 (4 pips, 19 items, 17 left), hex claimed with 5 roads + a settlement
brick: 3->5 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 48, hex 2 (5 pips, 22 items, 20 left), hex claimed with 0 roads + a settlement
wool: 3->4 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 168, hex 7 (2 pips, 13 items, 12 left), hex already ours
wheat: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 144, hex 6 (1 pips, 10 items, 9 left), hex already ours
ore: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 0, hex 0 (3 pips, 16 items, 15 left), hex claimed with 4 roads + a settlement

results.name: The hex number means two things: how many items it holds and how fast they come back
results.evidence:
5-pip hex 2 (brick): 22 items (declared 22), all 22 swept in 14 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 14s of 14s = 1.571 items/s sustained
1-pip hex 5 (wood): 10 items (declared 10), all 10 swept in 10 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 26s of 26s = 0.385 items/s sustained
more items on the better hex: true (22 vs 10) · faster regrowth: true (14s vs 26s) · 4.08x sustained supply
no swing speed involved: every item came off in a single frame of contact

then a settlement went up on corner 42: playerOwnsTile=true, canGatherTile=true, and the very next contact gave +1 ore
